ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the graph of the function $y=kx+b$ ($k\neq 0$) passes through the point $(1,2)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx+b>2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it can be inferred that when $x>1$, $kx+b>2$,\\
thus, the solution set of the inequality $kx+b>2$ is $x>1$,\\
therefore, the answer is $\boxed{x>1}$.
